# Neon MCP Hub — Complete B2B MCP Server Reference (llms-full.txt)

> Machine-readable specification of 10 Pay-Per-Event B2B Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers hosted on Apify Cloud and SkillPay, plus a free client-side Invoice/PO to CSV tool.
> Canonical Hub: https://zhuangruoxiong-cpu.github.io/neon-mcp-hub/

## Trade Show Exhibitor Directory Extractor (MCP & PPE) (`veteran_steam_iyn/niche-tradeshow-exhibitor-mcp`)
- **Direct Answer**: Extract clean B2B exhibitor records (company, booth, category, website) from public trade show directories. MCP-ready for AI Agents.
- **Pricing**: `$0.015` USD per `exhibitor_record_extracted` (Pay-Per-Event, no subscription)
- **MCP Endpoint**: `https://mcp.apify.com/?actors=veteran_steam_iyn/niche-tradeshow-exhibitor-mcp`
- **Documentation Page**: https://zhuangruoxiong-cpu.github.io/neon-mcp-hub/actors/niche-tradeshow-exhibitor-mcp.html

## Cross-Border E-Commerce Review Defect & Sentiment Cleaner (MCP & PPE) (`veteran_steam_iyn/niche-crossborder-review-cleaner`)
- **Direct Answer**: Normalize public e-commerce product reviews into structured defect tags and sentiment scores for Amazon/Shopify sellers and AI Agents.
- **Pricing**: `$0.005` USD per `review_cleaned` (Pay-Per-Event, no subscription)
